author: Mohammad Shoeybi, Mostofa Patwary, Raul Puri et al. (NVIDIA)
notes: Intra-layer (tensor) parallelism: two all-reduces in the forward pass and two in the backward pass per transformer layer. Not re-fetched live this session (fetch hosts blocked).

author: Yanping Huang, Youlong Cheng, Ankur Bapna et al. (Google)

author: Samyam Rajbhandari, Jeff Rasley, Olatunji Ruwase, Yuxiong He (Microsoft)
notes: Mixed-precision Adam needs ~16 bytes per parameter; ZeRO stages 1/2/3 shard optimizer states / gradients / parameters; stage 3 costs ~1.5x data-parallel communication. Not re-fetched live this session.

author: Hao Liu, Matei Zaharia, Pieter Abbeel
